name: printful-mcp
description: Printful print-on-demand tools for catalog search, mockups, sync products, and draft-only orders. Confirming an order is a separate explicit step.

interface.shortDescription: Search the Printful catalog and place draft orders without auto-confirming.
interface.longDescription: MCP server for the official Printful REST API. Look up catalog products and variants, estimate shipping and order costs, upload print files, generate mockups, and create sync products. create_order always saves a draft. The store payment method is charged only when confirm_order is called with confirm set to true. Website, repository, and logo are placeholders until a public listing is published. Developer: Bootheel Faith Co.
defaultPrompt: Search the Printful catalog for a unisex t-shirt and show the first matching product and its variants.
Estimate shipping and create a draft Printful order, then stop before confirmation.
